card: Ensures the invalidateblock RPC and validation layer properly report errors when block invalidation fails. Previously, if block disconnection failed midway (such as from missing or corrupt undo data), InvalidateBlock returned false without setting an error state, causing the RPC to report success despite leaving the active chain partially rolled back (issue #36546). The PR records specific error messages into BlockValidationState, adds an explicit RPC check preventing invalidation of the genesis block, and adds unit and functional test coverage.
changed_since_previous: Added an accidental modification to CMakeLists.txt linking src/pubkey.cpp to core_interface; the core logic for validation error reporting and genesis check remains the same.
evidence: Issue #36546: 'rpc: invalidateblock reports success when a block can't be disconnected'
PR description: 'If there is a problem disconnecting the block (for example, the undo data is corrupt), the chain remains partially rolled back when telling the user that the operation succeeded.'
problem: When InvalidateBlock fails during block disconnection (for example, due to corrupted undo data), the chain is left partially rolled back while the invalidateblock RPC silently ignores the failure and returns success (null) to the caller. Additionally, attempting to invalidate the genesis block is not explicitly validated up front.

risk.why: Touches block disconnection and invalidation error handling in validation, and includes a stray change to CMake build definitions.

scope_notes: CMakeLists.txt contains an apparent stray change adding src/pubkey.cpp to the core_interface target.
summary: Populates BlockValidationState with an error message when Chainstate::InvalidateBlock fails to disconnect a block or encounters an active-chain conflict during invalidation. Adds an explicit RPC parameter check to invalidateblock to reject invalidating the genesis block with RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER. Extends unit tests for disconnect failures due to missing undo data and functional tests for genesis block invalidation.
